data.title: Tesla must scale FSD, energy and robotics to justify $1.6 trillion valuation: ex-board member
data.description: The Westly Group's Steve Westly, a former Tesla board member, says the SpaceX and Tesla merger is likely given the synergies between the two firms. The key question is potential regulatory hurdles.
